One do-not-disturb box. Donations fell thirty percent.
Do you give because you want to, or because you can't say no?
In 2008, fundraisers knocked on over seven thousand doors near Chicago.
Some homes got a flyer first: we'll knock tomorrow, at this hour.
With a do-not-disturb box, a quarter fewer opened the door.
And giving fell thirty percent. Mostly gifts of ten dollars or less.
Mail or online instead? One household, out of seven thousand.
That awkward no? Priced at about three dollars fifty.
That's why one little box cut giving thirty percent.
